name: Kingdom of Angels
genericName: Angel Kingdoms||Kingdom of Angels||Kingdom of Angels
background:
The Kingdom of Angels is a faction made up mostly of Humans in the service of powerful angelic creatures. Their zealous infantry are protected by divine magic and supported by Angels who exude powerful auras over the battlefield. 

When the Great Rift opened, the people of this Kingdom were spared from destruction by the coming of the Angels. The Angels brought the people to safety beyond Tyria and taught them to worship new Twin Gods. Now they have returned to Tyria under the watchful eyes of the Angels, who offer their protection in exchange for total obedience.
backgroundFull:
When the Great Rift opened, its consequences were felt throughout Tyria. However, in one remote province along the southern border of the Empire, these consequences were particularly severe. The people of this province faced a series of catastrophes, as floods, hail, and wild fires raged throughout the region, destroying homes and crops, while the Rift cut them off from much of the Empire and their neighbours. 

It was in this time of catastrophe that the Angels revealed themselves. They presented themselves to the people and offered to take those who would follow them to a city in the sky, far from the destruction, so that they might return to rebuild in harmony with the Angels. The people came to know their new home as the Celestial City and they soon came to worship the Twin Gods of the Angels and obey their will as it was told to them by the Angels. They worked to improve their new city, their hands always guided by the watchful eyes of their angelic saviours. The youths were taught to view the Angels as saviours and protectors, and to trust in the words of their new guardians completely. After nearly two generations away, the Angel finally returned to Tyria with their followers. 

The people found their old homes abandoned and ruined, and the Angels instructed them to destroy what little remained, and sever any connections with their ancestors’ lives. Under the close supervision of the Angels, the people began to raise new temples and homes in the style of the Celestial City. These cities would serve as the core of their new realm in Tyria, and soon the Angels were ready to expand their flock. 

The Angels and their armies took to converting those who had come to the land in their absence. They offered rewards and favour to those who showed devotion and adopted the faith willingly, while crushing anyone who rebelled against them. Soon, the Angelic Kingdom began to look beyond its old provincial boundaries, seeking out strange magical relics and converting new followers, whether through preaching or conquest. They keep a close eye over their people, inspiring them forever towards greater faith in return for their salvation. 

While their followers profess the benevolence of their Angelic leaders, others in Tyria view the close supervision and strict commands of the Angels with suspicion, and some have begun to speculate that the Angels are working towards some secret ends beyond the knowledge of their followers. 

How will you spread the new faith?

specialRules.name: No Retreat Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get No Retreat. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Angelic Blessing
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, the first time they are attacked each round, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 2+ instead.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Deathstrike
specialRules.description: If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits.

specialRules.name: Fortified Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fortified. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Bane when Shooting
specialRules.description: This model gets Bane when shooting.

specialRules.name: Furious Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Furious. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Versatile Warrior Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 nearest friendly units within 12", which gets Versatile Warrior once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Slayer
specialRules.description: When shooting enemies over 9" away, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(27) or higher.

specialRules.name: Entrenched
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't moved during this round, enemy units shooting at them from over 12” away get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Spell Conduit
specialRules.description: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

specialRules.name: Brace in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Brace(1) in melee.

specialRules.name: Cumbersome
specialRules.description: May only use Hold or Advance actions, but can’t shoot when moving.

specialRules.name: Precision Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to hit rolls when attacking once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Crossing Strike
specialRules.description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way.

specialRules.name: Shatter
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+3).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Angelic Blessing
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Angelic Blessing, they always ignore wounds on rolls of 6+/2+ from Angelic Blessing (instead of only the first time they are attacked each round).

specialRules.name: Piercing Marksman Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Piercing Marksman. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Slayer Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Slayer against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Angelic Blessing Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 nearest friendly units within 12", which gets Enhanced Angelic Blessing once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Warding
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, the first time they are attacked each round, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 2+ instead.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Warding
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Warding, they always ignore wounds on rolls of 6+/2+ from Warding (instead of only the first time they are attacked each round).

specialRules.name: No Retreat
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a morale test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Bane
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: Furious
specialRules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Versatile Warrior
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when this unit attacks enemies for the first time each round, all models with this rule in it either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Caster
specialRules.description: Follows same rules as heroes, picking one random spell to cast, and spending all tokens to cast it when activated. If the chosen spell can’t be cast for any reason, then the model doesn’t cast.

specialRules.name: Brace
specialRules.description: Enemies charging this unit get -X total Impact rolls, unless this unit is Fatigued.

specialRules.name: Piercing Marksman
specialRules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Flying
specialRules.description: May move through units and terrain, and ignores the effects of terrain it doesn't end its move it. This unit automatically passes jumping rolls.
